entry.title: A Test Paper on Small Models
entry.summary: We show that a 10 million parameter model trained on curated text matches a 100 million parameter model on three reading benchmarks. The gap closes after two epochs of training.

entry.title: Another Test Paper on Retrieval
entry.summary: Retrieval over a local index halves the error rate on long questions compared with no retrieval. Gains are smaller for short questions.

entry.title: A Third Test Paper on Agents
entry.summary: Agents that share a memory of earlier attempts solve 30 percent more tasks than agents that do not. Sharing helps most on tasks that need many steps.
